question: How do I apply for admission?
answer: Admissions are done through a centralized entrance exam. Fill the online application form appear for the exam and attend the counselling session. Merit list is published on the portal.

question: When is the admission deadline?
answer: The admission deadline for this academic year is July 31st. Late applications are not accepted after this date.

question: Am I eligible for admission?
answer: To be eligible you must have passed 10+2 with at least 60% marks in Physics Chemistry and Mathematics.

question: What documents are needed for admission?
answer: Required documents: 10th marksheet 12th marksheet entrance exam scorecard birth certificate caste certificate (if applicable) and 4 passport-size photographs.

question: How to check my admission status?
answer: Check your admission status by logging into the student portal at portal.college.edu and entering your application number.

question: What scholarships are available?
answer: We offer Merit Scholarship, Need-based Scholarship, SC/ST Scholarship, and National Talent Scholarship. Apply through the scholarship portal before August 15th.

question: How do I get a merit scholarship?
answer: Merit Scholarship is awarded to students who score above 85% in their semester exams. It covers 50% of tuition fees.

question: How much is the scholarship?
answer: Scholarship amounts vary: Merit Scholarship covers ₹25,000/year, Need-based covers ₹15,000/year, and Government scholarships follow state rules.

question: How to apply for scholarship?
answer: Apply for scholarships through the college portal under the Scholarships section. Attach income certificate marksheets and a recommendation letter from HOD.

question: Is hostel available?
answer: The college provides separate hostels for boys and girls. Capacity is 500 for boys and 300 for girls. Apply early as seats are limited.

question: What are the hostel fees?
answer: Hostel fees are ₹40,000 per year including meals. Room-only accommodation is ₹25,000 per year.

question: What are the hostel rules?
answer: Hostel gates close at 10 PM. No visitors after 8 PM. Alcohol and smoking are strictly prohibited. Quiet hours are 10 PM to 6 AM.

question: How to apply for hostel?
answer: Submit the hostel application form to the Hostel Warden's Office by July 15th. Preference is given to outstation students.

question: What facilities does the hostel have?
answer: Hostel facilities include Wi-Fi, laundry, a common room with TV, 24-hour water supply, and a mess with home-cooked meals.

question: How much attendance is required?
answer: A minimum of 75% attendance is required in each subject to be eligible for semester examinations.

question: What if I have low attendance?
answer: If your attendance falls below 75% you will receive a warning letter. Below 65% you will be detained and cannot sit for exams.

question: Can I get attendance condonation?
answer: Attendance condonation is granted only for medical emergencies with valid hospital documents. Apply to the HOD within 7 days of rejoining.

question: How to check my attendance?
answer: Check your attendance on the student portal under My Attendance. It is updated every week by faculty.

question: When are the exams?
answer: Semester exams are held in November (odd semester) and April (even semester). The exam schedule is published 3 weeks before exams on the notice board.

question: How to get hall ticket?
answer: Hall tickets are available on the student portal 10 days before exams. You must show your hall ticket and college ID to enter the exam hall.

question: How to apply for revaluation?
answer: Revaluation requests can be submitted within 15 days after result declaration. The fee is ₹300 per subject. Apply at the Examination Office.

question: When will results be announced?
answer: Results are declared within 45 days after the last exam. Check results on the official college portal under Results.

question: How to clear backlog?
answer: Supplementary exams for backlog subjects are held 2 months after main results. Register through the exam portal and pay ₹500 per subject.

question: What can I bring to exam?
answer: You are allowed to carry only a pen pencil and approved scientific calculator. Mobile phones and smartwatches are strictly prohibited.

question: When is the library open?
answer: The library is open Monday to Saturday from 8 AM to 8 PM. It is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

question: How to borrow books?
answer: Students can borrow up to 3 books for 14 days. A fine of ₹2 per day is charged for late returns.

question: How to get library membership?
answer: Library membership is automatically given to all enrolled students. Use your student ID card to borrow books.

question: Are there ebooks available?
answer: The library provides access to NPTEL, IEEE Xplore, and Springer e-books. Log in with your college credentials on the library website.

question: What is the fee structure?
answer: Annual tuition fee: ₹80,000. Exam fee: ₹3,000 per semester. Lab fee: ₹5,000 per year. Development fee: ₹2,000 per year.

question: How to pay fees?
answer: Fees can be paid online through the college portal using UPI, Net Banking, or Credit/Debit cards. You can also pay at the accounts office by DD.

question: When is fee due?
answer: Fee payment deadline for the current semester is August 31st. A fine of ₹100 per day is charged after the deadline.

question: How to get fee receipt?
answer: Fee receipts are available on the student portal under Payments. Download the PDF receipt for your records.

question: Can I pay fees in installments?
answer: Fee installment facility is available for students in financial need. Submit an installment request to the Accounts Office with parent income proof.

question: How to apply for leave?
answer: Apply for leave through the student portal under Leave Application. Medical leave requires a doctor's certificate. Apply before the leave date when possible.

question: What is the medical leave policy?
answer: Medical leave is granted with a valid medical certificate. Submit the certificate within 3 days of rejoining. Extended medical leave (>7 days) requires HOD approval.

question: How to get casual leave?
answer: Casual leave of up to 2 days per month is allowed. Apply through the portal and inform your class teacher in advance.

question: How does placement work?
answer: Placement drives are held from October to February. Register on the placement portal attend pre-placement talks and appear for written tests and interviews.

question: Am I eligible for placements?
answer: To be eligible for placements you need a minimum 6.0 CGPA and no active backlogs. Some companies require 7.0+ CGPA.

question: Which companies come for recruitment?
answer: Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Accenture, Amazon, Microsoft, and many startups. 85% of eligible students get placed.

question: What is the average package?
answer: Average package is ₹6.5 LPA. Highest package last year was ₹24 LPA from a product-based company. Median is ₹5.2 LPA.

question: How to prepare for placements?
answer: Prepare with aptitude tests coding challenges and mock interviews. The Training and Placement cell runs workshops every Saturday at 10 AM.

question: How to contact faculty?
answer: Faculty contact details are listed on the college website under Faculty. You can also contact faculty during office hours (9 AM to 5 PM on working days).

question: When is faculty available?
answer: Faculty are available for student consultation from 11 AM to 12 PM and 2 PM to 3 PM on Monday Wednesday and Friday.

question: Who is the HOD?
answer: The HOD of CSE is Dr. Rajesh Kumar (rajesh@college.edu). For ECE contact Dr. Priya Sharma. For Mechanical contact Dr. Vikram Singh.

question: When is canteen open?
answer: The canteen is open from 8 AM to 6 PM on weekdays and 9 AM to 2 PM on Saturdays. It is closed on Sundays.

question: What food is available?
answer: The canteen serves breakfast (idli, dosa, upma), lunch (rice, roti, dal), and snacks (samosa, tea, coffee). A full meal costs ₹50.

question: What sports facilities are available?
answer: Sports facilities include a cricket ground, football field, basketball court, badminton hall, table tennis room, and a gym. All are free for enrolled students.

question: How to join sports team?
answer: College sports team tryouts are held in the first week of August. Check the notice board for specific timings for each sport.

question: What time does college start?
answer: College hours are 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM Monday to Saturday. The college is closed on Sundays and government holidays.

question: How to contact the principal?
answer: The Principal's office can be reached at principal@college.edu or by phone at +91-80-12345678. Office hours are 10 AM to 4 PM.

question: How to connect to college wifi?
answer: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus. Connect to CollegeNet and use your student ID and date of birth as password.

question: How to get transfer certificate?
answer: Transfer Certificates and Bonafide Certificates are issued by the admin office. Submit a written request and collect within 5 working days.

question: How to do internship?
answer: Internship registrations are open from January to March. You can pursue internships during summer vacations (May-June). Get approval from your HOD before joining.

question: What to do if I face ragging?
answer: Ragging is strictly prohibited. Report any incidents to the Anti-Ragging Committee at antiragging@college.edu or call the helpline 1800-180-5522.
